extName.description: Extension name shown in the browser and the stores.

extDescription.message: Plays every web video at 2× by default. Change the speed per video, or turn it off per site.

speedValue.description: A playback speed, such as 2× or 1.75×.

commandSpeedUp.message: Speed up the videos in this tab
commandSpeedUp.description: Shown next to the Alt+. shortcut in the browser's keyboard shortcut settings.

commandSlowDown.message: Slow down the videos in this tab
commandSlowDown.description: Shown next to the Alt+, shortcut in the browser's keyboard shortcut settings.

commandToggleSpeed.message: Switch between 1× and your default speed
commandToggleSpeed.description: Shown next to the Alt+R shortcut in the browser's keyboard shortcut settings.

popupSiteSwitch.description: Accessible name of the popup's on/off switch for the site in the address bar.

popupSiteSwitchUnavailable.message: Speed up videos on this page
popupSiteSwitchUnavailable.description: Accessible name of the popup's on/off switch on a page the extension can't run on, where the switch is disabled.

popupSiteOn.message: Videos play at your default speed.
popupSiteOn.description: Under the site name when the extension is on for the site.

popupSiteOff.message: Off. The site sets the speed.
popupSiteOff.description: Under the site name when the user has turned the extension off for the site.

popupSiteLocked.message: Off for all of $PATTERN$ by a rule in your site list.
popupSiteLocked.description: Under the site name when a rule covering the site and its subdomains turns it off, so the switch can't turn it on.

popupPageRestricted.message: Browsers don't let extensions run on this page.
popupPageRestricted.description: Shown instead of the site switch on browser pages (settings, new tab) and the extension stores.

popupPageNoSite.message: This page isn't on a website, so there's no site to turn off.
popupPageNoSite.description: Shown instead of the site switch on local files, which have no site name.

popupTabSpeed.description: Label of the popup's control for the speed of the videos in the current tab.

popupTabNoVideo.description: In place of this tab's speed in the popup, when the tab has no video.

popupTabOff.description: In place of this tab's speed in the popup, when the site is turned off.

badgeOff.description: Toolbar badge on a site the user turned off. Keep it to 3 or 4 characters.

popupDefaultSpeed.description: Label of the popup's control for the speed every video starts at.

popupDefaultSlower.description: Accessible name of the − button next to the default speed.

popupDefaultFaster.description: Accessible name of the + button next to the default speed.

popupSaveFailed.message: Couldn't save the change. Try again.
popupSaveFailed.description: Shown in the popup when the browser refuses to save a setting.
